existing.description: The SMU Merit Scholarship is a merit-based undergraduate award from Singapore Management University for Singapore Citizens entering a full-time degree programme, with up to 35 awards made each year. The published benefits, applying from Academic Year 2027-28, are a waiver of subsidised tuition fees for regular terms for up to 4 years and a S$12,000 growth opportunities allowance funding overseas community service projects and global exposure such as exchanges, summer programmes and study missions, together with Student Success Centre development opportunities. The scholarship is bond-free and lists no living allowance.
eligibility: Demonstrate strong leadership capabilities and potential
Possess excellent records in co-curricular and/or community activities
Be applying for admission to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at SMU
existing.eligibility_summary: Singapore Citizens applying for admission to a full-time SMU undergraduate degree programme, with outstanding academic results, strong leadership capabilities and potential, and excellent records in co-curricular and/or community activities. Up to 35 awards are made each year.
benefits: Subsidised tuition fee waiver for regular terms, semesters 1 and 2, for up to 4 years
Participation in development opportunities offered by the Student Success Centre
Flexibility to take a single or double degree
coverage: Waiver of annual subsidised tuition fees for regular terms, semesters 1 and 2, for up to 4 years, starting from Academic Year 2027-28
Growth opportunities allowance of S$12,000 for overseas community service projects and global exposure opportunities including overseas student exchanges, summer programmes and study missions
Participation in development opportunities offered by the Student Success Centre
requirements: Indicate interest in the Scholarship section of the online admission application form, as there is no separate scholarship application form
Enrol in a full-time undergraduate degree programme at SMU
documents: Scholarship personal essay completed and submitted online within the SMU admission application
Letters of recommendation from a tutor or principal, optional but strongly encouraged, submitted online by the referee
application_method: Submit the SMU undergraduate admission application form
Indicate interest in the award in the Scholarship section of that form
Complete the scholarship personal essay online as part of the admission application
Nominate a referee if seeking a letter of recommendation, allowing enough time for the referee to submit it online
Attend a panel interview at SMU if shortlisted
existing.selection_notes: Up to 35 SMU Merit Scholarships are awarded each year. Applicants are shortlisted based on their academic qualifications and the strength of their non-academic records, and shortlisted applicants are invited to SMU for a panel interview. Only shortlisted applicants are invited for interviews, and notifications are sent in batches between the dates published on SMU's Important Dates page.
existing.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leakers with outstanding academic results, strong leadership and excellent co-curricular or community records who want a bond-free four-year subsidised tuition waiver at SMU with funded overseas community service and exchange opportunities.
existing.notes: The published tuition waiver covers regular terms only, that is semesters 1 and 2, so special-term tuition is not covered. The published benefits carry the note "starting from Academic Year 2027-28", which is the cohort for which these figures apply. Unlike the SMU Global Impact Scholarship Award, the Merit Scholarship page lists no living allowance, computer allowance or Master's funding.
existing.duration: Up to 4 years of subsidised tuition fee waiver
existing.application_period: Tied to the SMU undergraduate admission cycle, published annually on SMU's Important Dates page. The published cycle for Academic Year 2026-27 ran 17 November 2025 to 19 March 2026; dates for the next intake were not published as at this verification.
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship application. Scholarship interest is indicated in the Scholarship section of the SMU undergraduate online admission application, which for Academic Year 2026-27 opened on 17 November 2025 and closed on 19 March 2026, Singapore Standard Time.

scholarships.title: Temasek Undergraduate Local Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: Temasek, administered by Singapore Institute of Technology

existing.description: The Temasek Undergraduate Local Scholarship is a merit-based award for talented students pursuing a full-time STEM undergraduate degree programme at the Singapore Institute of Technology, offered to polytechnic graduates. Each scholarship is valued at up to S$18,030 per annum, including an annual stipend of S$7,200, with a one-time S$2,000 laptop allowance in the first year of study and a possible one-time S$10,000 Global Mobility Grant for an eligible global exposure programme. It forms part of Temasek's S$150 million T-Spring community gift, made to mark the company's 50th anniversary in 2024, and is administered by Singapore Institute of Technology under its published Terms and Conditions.
eligibility: Pursue a full-time Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) undergraduate degree programme at the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT)
Be a meritorious student whom the donor wishes to nurture and recognise
SIT's terms and conditions apply to the scholarship
existing.eligibility_summary: Talented students pursuing a full-time Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics undergraduate degree programme at the Singapore Institute of Technology. The award sits under the Temasek Scholarship family and is part of Temasek's S$150 million T-Spring community gift marking its 50th anniversary in 2024.
benefits: Annual scholarship value of up to S$18,030
One-time laptop allowance of S$2,000 in the first year of study
Possible additional one-time Global Mobility Grant of S$10,000 for a University-conducted global exposure programme
coverage: Scholarship value of up to S$18,030 per annum, including an annual stipend of S$7,200
One-time laptop allowance of S$2,000 in the first year of study
Possible one-time Global Mobility Grant of S$10,000 for recipients who are eligible for and choose to attend a University-conducted global exposure programme
requirements: Study a full-time STEM undergraduate degree programme at the Singapore Institute of Technology
Refer to the Singapore Institute of Technology's published Terms and Conditions for the scholarship, which the official page links to
Be eligible for, and choose to attend, a University-conducted global exposure programme if the Global Mobility Grant is to be awarded
application_method: Apply through the Singapore Institute of Technology admissions process, which administers the scholarship
Refer to the Singapore Institute of Technology's published Terms and Conditions for the scholarship
existing.selection_notes: The award is described by the donor as merit-based, established to nurture and recognise talented students, and the administering institution publishes the governing Terms and Conditions separately. No interview, assessment or selection-stage information is published on the pages read, and no application window is stated.
existing.best_fit: Talented students seeking a full-time STEM undergraduate degree at the Singapore Institute of Technology who need financial support and, if eligible, a global exposure programme.
existing.notes: The detailed monetary terms are published by the administering institution, Singapore Institute of Technology, on its own Temasek Scholarship page, which Temasek's site links to from this award. The scholarship forms part of a S$150 million community gift named T-Spring, made by Temasek to mark its 50th anniversary in 2024. The published value of up to S$18,030 per annum is a cap, not a guaranteed amount, and the Global Mobility Grant is discretionary. Neither the Temasek hub page nor the administering institution's page read states an application deadline or closing date.
existing.duration: Annual award, renewed for each year of the full-time undergraduate degree programme while the recipient's eligibility continues
